project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (Eksotika Prima), server + client components, Prisma/libsql data layer
language: JavaScript (NOT TypeScript); .js/.jsx; 2-space indent; double quotes; import alias @/ -> src/
build_system: Next.js (next build). ES modules (package.json "type":"module"). React 19, next ^16.3.8.
test_framework: NONE installed. No unit/integration test runner in the repo (only transitive tests inside node_modules). Automated gates are lint + build only.
test_command: npm run lint  (and npm run build as the authoritative compile/SSR check)
verification_instructions: Run `npm run lint` then `npm run build`; both must succeed (lint may show only pre-existing warnings). There is no unit runner, so additionally do manual dev-server checks with `npm run dev` on http://localhost:3000: confirm the currency dropdown converts import prices live with no reload, persists across reloads/navigation via localStorage, keeps local price in IDR, and that server-rendered JSON-LD/metadata prices stay on the locale default (view-source / curl shows USD for /en, IDR for id regardless of browser selection).
environment_constraints: Work only inside the worktree d:\react project in SSD\Eksotika Prima\eksotika-prima-next\.worktrees\currency-selector on branch feat/currency-selector. cwd is the parent workspace, so reference every file with the absolute worktree path. Never read localStorage/window during server render. The branch is based on v-6.0 (mainline did not exist). No new heavy dependencies; a tiny dependency-free React context only. Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.dev) must be reachable at build/runtime for live rates; code must fall back to hardcoded rates when it is not.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo. Match existing code style: JavaScript only, 2-space indent, double quotes, @/ alias, functional React components, 'use client' at top of client files.
key_patterns: Server data flow: productService/newsService call applyImportCurrency*(.., locale) from src/lib/currency.js, which converts IDR import prices to the LOCALE default currency (id->IDR, en->USD) and OVERWRITES variant.importPrice/importDozenPrice/fromPrice, preserving raw IDR fromPrice as variant.fromPriceLocal and attaching product.importCurrency. Client price components currently read these pre-converted values. i18n: formatCurrency(price, currency) in src/lib/i18n.js (IDR 0 decimals, others up to 2); getTranslations(locale).nav holds navbar labels for both locales; getLocaleFromPathname/getLocalizedPath used by the navbar. Frankfurter v2 (VERIFIED): ?base=idr&quotes=usd,eur,gbp,... accepts a comma list and returns a FLAT ARRAY of {date,base,quote,rate} objects.
